scope: New single-invocation prompt pilot, not V004 replication. FORGE-only isolates prompt effects from source/memory access; RADAR/GAP adaptations are implemented but need a separately frozen stratified extension. PLAIN stays V001; existing HYBRID allocation is untouched.
ordering: All six permutations of the three arms, lexicographic arm-index order; one attempt per arm per block, equal position counts, no observed outputs used to choose order
primary_outcome: Distinct mechanisms independently judged worthy of a bounded M investigation per total human hour of generation supervision, review and duplicate/novelty assessment; report per reported token and generation-wall effort separately, never blend units
duplicate_credit: Human-reviewed mechanism clusters, counted once within each arm; a cluster found independently by multiple arms earns each arm credit once. Report cross-arm overlap separately; never award only the first chronological occurrence.

common_generation_rules.second_generation: Only evidenced append-only output-limit continuation; no repairs, retries, replacement, best-of, resume or extra parent

unbound_before_generation: owner identity/date and exact package consent
eligible seed/memory snapshots and cutoff, identical within each lane across arms
actual generation wall/human/review limits and independent reviewer identities
failure_policy: Preserve every reserved attempt and intended card slot, raw invalid/surplus/missing outputs, all failed work and undispatched slots after a stop. No replacement. Missing/conflicting usage or required effort is UNKNOWN. Content validity and resource classification remain separate. Do not report an incomplete comparison as complete.
scientific_limits: The 24 intended V004 cards cannot establish small performance differences. This 36-slot exploratory pilot is also not a power certificate; attempts, not paired cards, are generation units. No p-values, winner, promotion or universal creativity improvement follows from offline fixtures. A promising pilot needs a separately registered replication with an effort-relevant effect size.
M_boundary: M-investigation-worthy is a human proposal, not any of the six evidenced M requirements passed, H established, source acquisition authority, causal evidence or profitable alpha
